name: Kennedy Graham
status_detail: Retired from Parliament in 2017 after withdrawing as a Green candidate; no longer a Green member (party rejected his return in 2017). Founder of the New Zealand Center for Global Studies (2013). Not a 2026 candidate.
roles: Green spokesperson on foreign affairs, climate change, defence, disarmament, justice
Founder and chair of GLOBE-NZ cross-party climate group (2015)
Deputy chair, Foreign Affairs, Defence and Trade Committee
